visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright red backdrop featuring various colorful cartoon Shisa monster illustrations. A large white text box in the center introduces the topic. (2) A person's hands with manicured nails are shown against a clean white table, holding a yellow Calbee box. They open a small bag and pour out thin, beige potato sticks. (3) The scene shifts to a retail store display with stacks of blue boxes. A hand breaks a cookie sandwich to reveal a white cream filling with embedded grains. (4) A hand holds a Mickey Mouse-themed snack wrapper. The camera focuses on the hand breaking a light-colored, crumbly cookie sandwich to show a creamy interior. (5) A red and brown chocolate cookie wrapper is shown. The hand breaks a small, dark brown circular cookie, revealing a thick chocolate paste inside. (6) A storefront with a red neon sign for '泡盛' is shown, followed by three clear glass bottles of local alcohol with colorful labels on a white table. (7) A small blue 'Orion Beer Nuts' bag is held, and the hand pours small tan-colored nuts into a white ceramic dish under bright indoor lighting. (8) A box and individual bags of Calbee sweet potato snacks are displayed. A hand pours out small, bite-sized purple and yellow cubes onto a plate. (9) The camera pans over glazed ring cakes on wooden shelves, then shows a large red industrial oven where multiple cakes are rotating on spits. (10) A black box with a man's face illustration is opened. A hand breaks a pitch-black cookie sandwich to show a white filling in a tight close-up. (11) An orange bag with a cartoon monk character is held. A hand retrieves a small, round, beige cookie and shows its texture to the camera. (12) A large, colorful mascot statue in a yellow kimono and red hat sits on a red bench. The video ends with a pink card listing social media handles.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 沖縄伴手禮 10選. [Variety]: 開箱試吃全分享!. (2) [Subtitle]: 1. Calbee 塔可飯口味薯條棒. [Variety]: 吃起來真的有很濃的肉醬香香味 適合當追劇小零嘴. [Logo]: @japanuts. (3) [Subtitle]: 2. 雪鹽 厚夾心餅乾. [Variety]: 我心中的好吃第一名. 內餡是雪鹽的白巧克力奶油 加入了脆脆的玉米片. 吃起來不會太甜~ 讚讚. (4) [Subtitle]: 3. 迪士尼包裝 鹽焦糖達克瓦茲. [Variety]: 包裝超級可愛 很適合送人. 內餡是沖繩熬製的焦糖 吃起來甜甜鹹鹹、口感鬆軟. (5) [Subtitle]: 4. 御菓子御殿 黑糖巧克力餅乾. [Variety]: 不是麻糬! 是黑糖餅乾中包裹著巧克力醬. 裡面還咬得到黑糖顆粒 有被驚艷到!. (6) [Subtitle]: 5. 沖縄泡盛酒. [Variety]: 沖繩當地特產的地酒 是日本最古老的蒸餾酒. 很多地方都有販售這種小瓶裝的喔. (7) [Subtitle]: 6. Orion 花生豆. [Variety]: 小小一包~ 適合配酒. 是使用啤酒酵母菌製作而成的 吃起來很涮嘴. (8) [Subtitle]: 7. Calbee 限定黑糖薯塊. [Variety]: 這個只有在國際通 Calbee+ 有賣! 黑糖味剛好~ 會一口接一口. (9) [Subtitle]: 8. 福木屋 年輪蛋糕. [Variety]: 使用沖繩當地食材製作 有很多不同的口味. 蛋糕體濕潤、偏甜~ 適合配咖啡. 味道真的好香. (10) [Subtitle]: 9. 黑濃人 紅薯巧克力餅乾. [Variety]: 一開始是因為包裝很好笑才買 結果意外的好吃!. 黑色的貓舌餅乾 內餡是久米島的紅薯混合巧克力. 紅薯味香濃而且不會太甜. (11) [Subtitle]: 10. 久米島 元祖味噌餅乾. [Variety]: 使用久米島味噌製成. 咬起來口感像方塊酥~ 鹹香味很特別. (12) [Variety]: 不知道怎麼挑沖繩伴手禮 跟著買就對了!. 看更多資訊請點 IG 首頁連結.
